```{r}

get_otu_asv_by_sample <- function(ps) {
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }
  otu
}

# compute otu's prevalence
compute_prevalence <- function(ps) {
  otu <- get_otu_asv_by_sample(ps)
  rowMeans(otu > 0)
}


# calculate reads and asv loss thresholds
evaluate_filter <- function(ps, prev_cutoff) {

  otu <- get_otu_asv_by_sample(ps)

  prev <- rowMeans(otu > 0)
  keep_taxa <- prev >= prev_cutoff

  if (!any(keep_taxa)) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        prev_cutoff = prev_cutoff,
        frac_ASVs_removed  = 1,
        frac_reads_removed = 1
      )
    )
  }

  reads_before <- sum(otu)
  reads_after  <- sum(otu[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE])

  tibble::tibble(
    prev_cutoff = prev_cutoff,
    frac_ASVs_removed  = 1 - mean(keep_taxa),
    frac_reads_removed = 1 - reads_after / reads_before
  )
}



# function to clean physeq object
clean_phyloseq_ASVs <- function(
  ps,
  min_reads = 250,
  max_frac_reads_removed = 0.20,
  max_frac_ASVs_removed  = 0.40,
  prevalence_grid = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.01)
) {

  ## 1️⃣ Drop low-depth samples
  ps <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps) >= min_reads, ps)

  ## Safety
  if (nsamples(ps) == 0)
    stop("No samples left after read-depth filtering.")

  ## 2️⃣ Evaluate prevalence cutoffs
  eval_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
    prevalence_grid,
    ~ evaluate_filter(ps, .x)
  )

  ## 3️⃣ Keep only valid thresholds
  valid <- eval_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      frac_reads_removed <= max_frac_reads_removed,
      frac_ASVs_removed  <= max_frac_ASVs_removed
    )

  if (nrow(valid) == 0)
    stop("No prevalence threshold satisfies the constraints.")

  ## 4️⃣ Pick the *most stringent* valid cutoff
  best_prev <- max(valid$prev_cutoff)

  ## 5️⃣ Apply it
  prev <- compute_prevalence(ps)
  ps_clean <- prune_taxa(prev >= best_prev, ps)

  ## 6️⃣ Report
  message("Chosen prevalence cutoff: ", round(best_prev, 2))
  message("Reads removed: ",
          scales::percent(valid$frac_reads_removed[valid$prev_cutoff == best_prev]))
  message("ASVs removed: ",
          scales::percent(valid$frac_ASVs_removed[valid$prev_cutoff == best_prev]))

  return(ps_clean)
}

#test on ps_16S_rare_expe_D1
cleaned_ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- clean_phyloseq_ASVs(ps = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1,
  min_reads = 250,
  max_frac_reads_removed = 0.20,
  max_frac_ASVs_removed  = 0.40,
  prevalence_grid = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.01)
)

eval_tbl %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("frac"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(prev_cutoff, value, color = metric)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.2, 0.4), linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Prevalence cutoff",
    y = "Fraction removed"
  )



eval_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  prevalence_grid,
  ~ evaluate_filter(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, .x)
)

eval_tbl
print(eval_tbl,n=91)

```
